title: Uniform and Orchard
author: Noor Ashgrove
blurb: Jude Quintana, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
